name: Necromancer: Gravebound Champion buff ends when the Champion dies (#4139)
contract: Gravebound Champion 805049 summons creature 500482 for 20000 ms (DurationIndex 18) and reads 'Summon a Gravebound Champion that redirects $805050s3% of all damage the caster takes to themselves for $d.' The Champion carries passive 805050, whose effect 2 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_OWNER with SPELL_AURA_SPLIT_DAMAGE_PCT, BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = 50, radius index 12 (100 yd), so the owning Necromancer is buffed with 50% damage redirection while the Champion stands. The redirection is the Champion's own, so the buff must end with the Champion. Sacrifice Undead 807938 (family 29 word 2 0x4000000) kills every Necromancer minion, Champions included, about 3 s into the 20 s lifetime; the owner must lose 805050 within 2 s instead of keeping it until the timed despawn.

steps.label: Let login and the Life Force aura settle
CONTROL: no Champion buff before the summon
SETUP: one Gravebound Champion is summoned
The Necromancer is aided by the Gravebound Champion
The buff redirects 50% of damage taken
SETUP: the Gravebound Champion is dead
DISCRIMINATING: the buff ends with the Champion, not at its 20 s despawn
